name: 1hack — AI Weekend 2026
theme: Applied AI. Open challenges: build whatever you want with AI in the mix. 24h in person at FIC (A Coruña).
judgingPeriod: Sat 14 Nov 2026 19:00-21:00 CET: after party & voluntary live demos

eligibility.teamSize: no limit; solo welcome, teams form on site
eligibility.notes: Max 100 spots, 10 EUR ticket. No AI credits provided: bring your own API keys.

submission.demo: Live demo on stage, voluntary, ~2-3 minutes, laptop or phone
other: No published prizes, rubric or submission rules: optimise for a live wow demo, a credible real problem and traction (survey data, LOIs)

stages: Live demos at the after party

criteria.name: Live demo wow
criteria.description: Assumed: works live, end to end, in under 3 minutes

criteria.name: Real problem and impact
criteria.description: Assumed: grounded in real data, potential customers and LOIs

criteria.name: Applied AI depth
criteria.description: Assumed: AI does real work, not a chatbot wrapper

criteria.name: Sponsor fit (RevenueCat)
criteria.description: Assumed: real in-app monetisation with RevenueCat

sponsors.name: RevenueCat
sponsors.tool: In-app subscriptions SDK (web/iOS/Android), Paywalls, Experiments, Charts
